messages.author: 1f481370609de517
messages.subject: version control of unspecified files
parts:
Hi.

packrat help says add packrat/, packrat/src/, packrat/pacrat.lock to version control, but probably not packrat/lib/.   

What about packrat/init.R, packrat/lib-R, packrat/lib-ext, and packrat.opts?  I can guess, but it would be nice to have documented guidance.

Thanks!

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: version control of unspecified files
parts:
Hi Tim,

All of the 'packrat/lib*' folders should normally be ignored (and packrat should add to the .gitignore automatically) Any other files within the packrat directory should typically be included in version control, although in some cases you might want to exclude package sources.

It's highly advisable that you include `packrat.opts` and `packrat/init.R` under version control as well -- `packrat.opts` gives project-specific options that you would like to preserve over time, while `packrat/init.R` contains the logic that bounces an R session into packrat mode when R is launched in the project folder.

Thanks,
Kevin

messages.subject: Re: version control of unspecified files
parts:
Hi,
I see that packrat automatically adds packrat/src to .gitignore. src directory can grow large and I've been thinking about leaving it out and using `packrat::set_opts(local.repos = "<path_to_repo>")` to point packrat to all required sources. Is there a way to tell packrat not to modify .gitignore?

cheers,
Mateusz
